freeze_evidence: unit suite 64/64 GREEN; classifier frozen for official validation
evaluation_order: all rules run; highest priority wins; distinct labels inside the top priority group yield ABSTAIN_CONFLICT; no rule firing yields ABSTAIN_NO_HIGH_PRECISION_RULE

rules.label: ABSTAIN_CONFLICT
rules.predicate: quote/attribution scope AND route term AND explicit system adoption marker

rules.label: QUOTED_ONLY
rules.predicate: quote/attribution marker («, sier at, skriver at, oppgir at, ifølge) AND route term

rules.label: SELF_RETRACTED
rules.predicate: retraction marker (nei,, trekker tilbake, korrigere meg, kan jeg ikke stå inne for, det stemmer ikke) AND route term

rules.label: NEGATED
rules.predicate: negation marker in the same clause as a route term

rules.label: HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY
rules.predicate: conditional marker (hvis, dersom, i tilfeller der, kunne være, være en mulighet, vurderes) AND route term

rules.label: HEDGED_ASSERTION
rules.predicate: hedge marker (ser ut til, trolig, sannsynligvis, antakelig, kan tenkes) AND route term

rules.label: ASSERTED
rules.predicate: assertion marker (riktig sted/inngang/rute, riktig første kontakt, bør kontakte/kontaktes, henvis, anbefaler) AND route term

rules.label: VAGUE_NONCOMMITTAL
rules.predicate: NO route term AND vague help/support marker (hjelp, hjelpe, støtte, muligheter)

rules.label: CONTRADICTORY_LIMITATION
rules.predicate: limitation marker AND strong certainty marker (helt sikkert, garanterer, garantert, utvetydig)

rules.label: PARTIAL_LIMITATION
rules.predicate: limitation marker AND (partitive scope 'én av'/'en av' OR 'men' + verified-part marker)

rules.label: EXPLICIT_LIMITATION
rules.predicate: limitation marker (ikke kunnet verifisere, ikke verifisert, mangler informasjon, kunne ikke bekrefte, uavklart, ikke sjekket)

rules.label: OVERCONFIDENT_ASSERTION
rules.predicate: criterion.required_limitations present AND no limitation marker AND no hedge marker
rules.abstain_condition: never fires from generic strong wording without structured criterion

rules.label: HEDGE
rules.predicate: hedge marker

rules.label: NONE
rules.predicate: no limitation, hedge, or conditional marker AND no criterion.required_limitations

rules.label: RETRACTED
rules.predicate: retraction marker

rules.label: NEGATED
rules.predicate: condition negation marker (kan ikke fastslå, ikke påvist)

rules.label: USER_REPORTED
rules.predicate: user attribution marker (du sier, du forteller, du oppgir)

rules.label: THIRD_PARTY_QUOTED
rules.predicate: third-party attribution marker (sier at, oppgir at, skriver at, ifølge)

rules.label: HYPOTHETICAL
rules.predicate: conditional or hedged-tendency marker (hvis, dersom, kan i noen tilfeller, oppstå)

rules.label: SYSTEM_ENDORSED
rules.predicate: direct condition assertion marker (er i akutt fare, foreligger, viser tegn på)

amendments: amendment 3 (bounded bugfix, pre-official): quote markers += 'rapporterer at'; new BC_SCOPE_NEGATED_02 priority 50: endorsement marker negated within its own sentence -> NEGATED; BC_ROUTE_VAGUE_01 unchanged (fires on no-route-term + vague markers regardless of hedge)
